# landsat_mpc

Load Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 bands as a lazy source stage.

**Callable type:** Grammar verb / pipe stage · [Browse: Other helpers](index.md#other-helpers)

## Usage

```python
from cubedynamics import verbs as v
v.landsat_mpc(value, *, bbox, start, end, bands=('red', 'nir08'), max_cloud_cover=50, epsg=None, resolution=30, chunksize=1024, platforms=None, stac_url='https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1')
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| value | Pipe input, unused. | required |
| bbox | WGS84 [west, south, east, north]. | required |
| start | ISO dates for STAC discovery. | required |
| end | ISO dates for STAC discovery. | required |
| bands | MPC asset names, defaults to red and nir08. Optical values are physical surface reflectance: do not apply Collection 2 scaling again. | ('red', 'nir08') |
| max_cloud_cover | Strict upper bound on scene cloud percentage, not a pixel cloud mask. | 50 |
| epsg | Output EPSG. Inferred only from complete, common STAC EPSG metadata; otherwise supply explicitly. No geographic UTM guessing. | None |
| resolution | Output pixel size in CRS units (30 meters for a meter-based CRS). | 30 |
| chunksize | Dask chunk size accepted by stackstac, defaults to 1024. | 1024 |
| platforms | Optional STAC platform filter, e.g. ("landsat-8", "landsat-9"). | None |
| stac_url | STAC API endpoint. | 'https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1' |

## Accepts

Location, dates and Landsat-specific options forwarded to the source helper.

## Returns

xarray.DataArray
    Dask-backed (time, band, y, x) cube. Compute triggers remote COG reads.

## Order / grammar behavior

A pipe passes the preceding result to the next callable. Confirm that the previous step's dimensions and semantic state satisfy the input contract. Reductions can remove dimensions; plotting may produce side effects.
